answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an economy of AI agents can require each identity to lock scarce stake and prove unique work: every agent burns real compute to mint a signed identity thread, embedding a one-of-a-kind cryptographic opal that cannot be cloned or reused. The cost of spinning up a nebula of fake personas then exceeds what those shills could ever earn, so impersonation collapses under its own economics. Verifiers audit the ledger and reject any duplicate credential because its unique attestation has already been claimed.
